candidates.label: RWO owns structural quorum counting
candidates.ownerGate: RWO composition-form owner plus journal-acceptance owner
evidence: DESIGN.md#5.3 explicitly lists quorum(n) as a structural FanIn release condition and assigns semantic reconciliation to the join Work.
The refined findings reuse ReleasePolicy and permit RWO to fold eligible structural arrivals while keeping quality, consensus, truth, and approval outside the kernel.
The audited fixture contract defines zero, above-count, lower-positive, and upper-positive quorum boundaries after owner closure.

candidates.label: A Decision Work owns quorum release
candidates.ownerGate: RWO composition-form owner plus Decision Work domain owner
evidence: The existing Gate boundary allows a Work to own a decision and emit one opaque route label that RWO matches exactly.
Moving quorum to a Decision Work prevents RWO from owning even count-based release but requires explicit decision execution and evidence.
The refined findings identify Decision Work as the alternative when structural quorum is not RWO-owned.

candidates.label: Count transport deliveries toward quorum
rejectionReasons: Transport delivery is not journal acceptance and redelivery must not create a second logical arrival.
The adapter boundary explicitly forbids transport acknowledgement or delivery from becoming journal truth or recovery.

candidates.label: Let RWO evaluate weighted or qualified quorum
rejectionReasons: Weight, qualification, approval, quality, or agreement introduces domain meaning rather than structural counting.
No named semantic or authority owner gate permits the RWO kernel to evaluate those predicates.

candidates.label: Defer quorum ownership
evidence: Deferral preserves the candidate but keeps quorum-bearing FanIn schemas, fixtures, and runtime schedules blocked.

candidates.label: Stop the composition-form Decision Gate
evidence: Stopping preserves current source and candidate bytes and authorizes no downstream mutation.
